summary: Iteration 6 backend-only testing of 3-day Onboarding Quest endpoints. 8/8 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_quest.py PASSED on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (4.7s). Covered: (1) auth gating on GET /api/onboarding/quest -> 401, (2) initial quest shape {tasks[6 each with day/key/label/metric/done], completed:false, claimed:false, tasks_done:0, tasks_total:6, reward_xp:200, badge:'Welcome Streak', days_since_signup:int>=0}, (3) day groupings exactly Day1=[day1_chat,day1_lesson] Day2=[day2_pron,day2_vocab] Day3=[day3_writing,day3_grammar], (4) POST /api/onboarding/quest/claim before completion -> 400, (5) organic metric flip via POST /api/grammar/check flips day3_grammar.done=true (and verified user_metrics.grammar_checks>=1 in Mongo), (6) simulated full completion by directly setting user_metrics doc (pronunciation_good/conversation_messages/lessons_completed/vocab_words_seen/writing_submitted/grammar_checks), GET returns completed:true claimed:false tasks_done:6, POST /claim -> {already_claimed:false, xp_awarded:200, badge:'Welcome Streak'}, second claim -> {already_claimed:true, xp_awarded:0}, GET /api/progress XP delta == exactly 200, XP unchanged on second claim, (7) regression /api/challenge/today still returns full shape, (8) regression /api/lessons still returns list. State pre-cleared via mongosh for user_metrics/onboarding_quests/challenges/usage_logs collections of test-user-english-coach.

minor.issue: _quest_state uses feature_totals (from usage_logs) + aggregate (user_metrics) for each metric — this double counts when the same metric accidentally appears in both stores. Currently safe because the wrapped increment_challenge_metric writes to user_metrics only and no task metric matches a free-tier feature key, but brittle if future endpoints start logging a task metric into usage_logs.
days_since_signup parses created_at via datetime.fromisoformat which fails silently for ISO strings ending in 'Z' (returns 0). Consider normalizing 'Z' -> '+00:00' before parsing.

action_items: None blocking for this iteration. Optional: harden days_since_signup ISO parsing and remove the usage_logs double-read path in _quest_state (aggregate-only is sufficient since increment_challenge_metric writes to user_metrics).
Carryover from iter5 (not re-tested here): writing_feedback already calls increment_challenge_metric('writing_submitted',1) at server.py L442 — iter5 bug is fixed. Re-run iter5 suite if needed.
Long-standing: server.py is now 1240 lines — split into routers (auth/profile/lessons/billing/checkin/challenge/onboarding/llm).
critical_code_review_comments: _quest_state aggregates feature_totals from usage_logs AND user_metrics and sums them per metric — harmless today but a latent bug; pick one source of truth (user_metrics).

Wrapping pattern (_orig_increment_challenge_metric then re-binding name) at server.py L1097-1102 works but is brittle — anyone importing increment_challenge_metric at module-import time (e.g. from another module) would get the un-wrapped version. Prefer calling _bump_metric directly from within increment_challenge_metric.
POST /api/onboarding/quest/claim returns 200 on second claim with already_claimed:true — consistent with /api/challenge/claim. Good.

No idempotency concern around simultaneous claims: update_one with $set claimed:true after a state check — a race could double-award XP. Consider a conditional update ({claimed: {$ne: true}}) before crediting XP.
server.py ~1240 lines — past 700-line threshold; routers split overdue.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_english_coach_v1 (user_id=test-user-english-coach, is_premium=false). Session still valid.
